source: The Age of Decadence is a very different game from what you're used to. Its world is harsh and unforgiving and it really doesn't take much to end up dead. In fact, it's painfully easy, especially if you try to play the game the way you normally play RPGs, when you role-play a mighty hero who's able to handle any challenge and smite evildoers by the dozens.
scope_note: Title-menu labels may remain English by user preference; runtime usage must be checked for editor-folder assets.
target_draft: 『The Age of Decadence』は、慣れ親しんだゲームとは大きく異なる。その世界は過酷で容赦がなく、ほんの些細なことで命を落とす。実際、死ぬのは嫌になるほど簡単だ。とりわけ、どんな難題も乗り越え、悪党を何十人もなぎ倒す強大な英雄になりきって、いつものRPGと同じように遊ぼうとすれば、なおさらだ。

source: In this game combat is always extremely dangerous. It is the hardest way to handle quests and progress through the game and even a couple of thugs can easily put an end to your adventure.
scope_note: Title-menu labels may remain English by user preference; runtime usage must be checked for editor-folder assets.
target_draft: このゲームでは、戦闘は常に極めて危険だ。依頼をこなし、先へ進む方法の中でも最も難しく、たった二人のならず者にさえ、あっさり冒険を終わらされかねない。

source: Keep in mind that you are NOT expected to beat every fight you're offered. There is no shame in walking away if your character isn't a killing machine. Optional fights are usually the hardest, so don't jump at the first opportunity to be brutally murdered. The game isn't linear and it's not about killing people.
scope_note: Title-menu labels may remain English by user preference; runtime usage must be checked for editor-folder assets.
target_draft: 持ちかけられる戦いすべてに勝つ必要はない。このことを忘れないでほしい。君のキャラクターが殺戮の達人でないなら、戦わずに立ち去っても恥ではない。任意の戦闘はたいてい最も難しい。戦う機会が来たからといって、むざむざ殺されに飛び込まないことだ。このゲームは一本道ではなく、人を殺すことが目的でもない。

source: Be aware that many people will not hesitate to lie to you, steal from you, or betray you, should they see fit. Use your head, be careful what you say, and always look out for yourself, because no one else will.

target_draft: 多くの人間は、そうするのが得策だと判断すれば、ためらいもなく君に嘘をつき、君から盗み、君を裏切る。頭を使い、発言には気をつけ、常に自分の身を守ることだ。ほかの誰も守ってはくれない。
